ariadneApp

ariadneApp is a Shiny app for interactively exploring the ariadne resource graph that is stored in ariadneDB. Thus, it is an interactive alternative to the R package ariadne and its Python extension ariadnePy. With this app, it is possible to dynamically explore the ariadne resource graph, select pathways and ultimately cross the graph to link features from different databases.

Usage

ariadneApp is currently not available as a web app (this may change in the future). Alternatively, it can be installed and deployed locally. For local use, Internet connection is required.

Installation instructions

The app can be installed as follows:

remotes::install_github("Minotau-R/ariadneApp")

Example

In the local environment, you can import the app and launch it as follows:

# Import package
library(ariadneApp)

# Launch app
shinePath()
